title: Schedule of No-Show and Cancellation Penalty — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A traveller holding a ticket under Air Ticket Fare Brands who neither flies nor cancels before the outbound departure is recorded as a no-show, and the no-show penalty of the fare brand held is withheld from whatever value the ticket still carries.

| Position on the booking | What is withheld |
|---|---|
| A recorded no-show on the outbound | The no-show penalty of the brand held, taken from the value the ticket still carries |
| The return leg after a no-show on the outbound | Nothing further. The return is unusable on every brand, and is treated as cancelled on that brand's own terms once the no-show penalty has been withheld |
| A cancellation made before the outbound departure | The cancellation penalty of the brand held |
| The airline did not operate the flight | Nothing. No penalty is withheld where the traveller could not travel for that reason, and the disruption terms apply instead |

**A cancellation penalty and a no-show penalty are never withheld against the same ticket.** Whichever of the two applies replaces the other.

**The amount actually withheld.** For a no-show the amount withheld is the lower of two figures: the no-show penalty of the brand held, and the value the ticket still carries. Where the value still on the ticket is the smaller, the penalty is limited to that value and no balance is pursued. Worked on hypothetical figures, taking an illustrative no-show penalty of 140.00 US dollars, a figure standing as the penalty of no brand: against a ticket still carrying 320.00 US dollars, the amount withheld is 140.00 US dollars and the ticket is left carrying 180.00 US dollars; against a ticket still carrying 90.00 US dollars, the amount withheld is 90.00 US dollars, and the shortfall of 50.00 US dollars is not pursued.

**Footnote on the party travelling.** The infant share of a fare and the child discount of the brand held are applied before the penalty is measured, so that a penalty is never larger than what that traveller actually paid.
